input.quote: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: Section 14.1 preserves our ownership of Customer Data and pre-existing IP, and Section 14.4 bars joint ownership, so those elements are fine. But Section 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created specifically for us (as defined in Section 1.4) with only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term. That fails both the preferred position (Customer owns deliverables, Vendor assigns) and the fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables). Section 13.2's perpetual licence does not cure it: by its terms it covers software and Vendor Technology delivered paid-up or embedded in a Deliverable, not the Deliverable itself, and Section 14.3 confirms that limited scope. Redline flips ownership to Customer with an express assignment while leaving Vendor Technology with Vendor under Sections 14.3 and 13.2.

proposal.summary: Flip Deliverable ownership to Customer with Vendor assignment; Vendor Technology remains Vendor's under 14.3
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We own what we pay for, so we have flipped Section 14.2 so that Vendor assigns each Deliverable created for us rather than owning it under a revocable, term-limited licence. Vendor keeps its pre-existing Vendor Technology under Section 14.3, and the perpetual licence in Section 13.2 continues to cover any Vendor Technology embedded in a Deliverable; if ownership is not workable, our fallback is Vendor ownership plus a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for us to use, modify and sublicense Deliverables for our business.

ops.oldText: Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest, including all intellectual property rights, in each Deliverable upon its creation. Vendor retains Vendor Technology as provided in Section 14.3, and the perpetual licence in Section 13.2 applies to Vendor Technology incorporated in or required to use a Deliverable.
